from sqlfmt.api import format_string
from sqlfmt.mode import Mode
from sqlfmt.ddl import parse_ddl_table
s='CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id INT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2), CHECK (id > 0), PRIMARY KEY (id));'
r=format_string(s,Mode()); print(r); print('idempotent:',format_string(r,Mode()) == r)
print(parse_ddl_table(Mode().dialect.initialize_analyzer(line_length=88).parse_query(s).lines))
